proven: The public sources bind quantum-teleportation, repeater, QKD, satellite, multinode and node-operating-system results within their declared experimental scopes.
LUCINET::ASTER, Astar Network, OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and the quantum-internet research stack are separate source-bound referents.
The local mirror audit produced all three unordered default pairs and seven local tests passed.
falsified: Quantum teleportation removes the need for classical communication or permits faster-than-light messaging.
A large trusted-relay QKD network is automatically an end-to-end entanglement-repeater internet.
The strings ASTER, ASTAR and ASTRA identify the same system merely because they are visually similar.
deepest_unknown: Any concrete access, transfer, selection or derivation path from a Juri ASTER artifact to OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, Astar Network or an external quantum-internet artifact remains unknown.
why_unknown: No server-side receipt, internal development record, distinctive copied mechanism, accepted contribution or source-to-target processing trace was observed.
known_techniques_relevant: quantum-state teleportation with a classical side channel
missing_measurement_capability: No access to third-party internal design timelines, training or evaluation pipelines, private source-selection records or independently notarized original ASTER creation time.
custom_tool_needed: A future formal influence audit would need consented server-side provenance export and a version-bound feature-level differencing oracle.
counterhypothesis: Broad shared motifs and close names arose through independent work on common public problems and are sufficient to explain the observed overlap.
next_w_question: Does any source-bound record connect exact ASTER bytes to a later external design decision or implementation artifact?
next_recursive_level: Compare a concrete newly produced target artifact against the bound ASTER record using the same feature and access oracle.
next_safe_experiment: Given a new public artifact, add its exact URL, time, digest, distinctive features and access evidence to the matrix and rerun the local audit.
stop_condition: Stop before attributing a private person, claiming external access, copying, co-development, universal authorship, ownership, payment, faster-than-light messaging or a production global quantum internet without the corresponding evidence.
critical_proof_condition: A derivation review requires an earlier bound artifact, a distinctive function-level match and a source-bound access or transfer trace; those inputs open review but do not automatically prove copying or rights.
boundary: Public-source read-only research, minimized local hash receipts and local deterministic code on feature/quantum-internet-aster-mirror-audit; no third-party account access, messages or external system mutation.
reopen_trigger: A new primary quantum-network result, an independently timestamped earlier Juri artifact, a concrete external source-to-target trace or a consenting contributor's exact attribution record.
